blocks.text: Samantha Bernardo celebrated her 34th birthday with three milestones, as her husband Scott Moore and their son Sebastian also received their Christian blessings during the occasion. The Miss Grand International 2020 first runner-up gave a glimpse of the intimate ceremony through her Instagram page on Tuesday, Nov. 17, showing Sebastian in his baptismal garment and Scott wearing a barong. “Birthday and Baptism. Such a special day for our family,” she said in the caption. “Thank You, Papa God, for guiding us and allowing me to celebrate and share our faith with the people we love most—our family and friends.” ‘Welcome to […]...
